decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is central to the firm's announced move into digital inline marking and represents substantial development investment, so only a year after launch management would attribute any weak results to normal market ramp-up and persist.

The numbering software module was publicly announced as an extension of the firm's software portfolio for variable-data printing, costs little to maintain, and supports the hardware line, so there is strong commitment and little reason to withdraw it.

The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces opens new application markets in line with the firm's inkjet strategy, and with sunk development costs and a visible launch, management would keep it and treat early disappointment as temporary.
